description: Documentation for the FrameLocator class in Playwright, detailing its methods, usage, and behavior regarding iframe element handling.

classes.name: FrameLocator
classes.description: Represents a view into an iframe on the page, allowing element location and interaction within that iframe context.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns locator to the first matching frame. Deprecated; use Locator.first followed by contentFrame.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns locator to the last matching frame. Deprecated; use Locator.last followed by contentFrame.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a new FrameLocator entering the iframe to enable nested element selection.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements by alt text within the iframe.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements by label text within the iframe.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a Locator for input placeholders within the iframe.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements matching ARIA roles within the iframe.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specific test IDs within the iframe.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements containing specific text within the iframe.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements by title attribute within the iframe.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a Locator within the iframe based on the selector or locator passed.

methods.name: nth
methods.description: Returns a locator for the n-th matching frame. Deprecated; use Locator.nth followed by contentFrame.

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns a Locator pointing to the iframe element itself, useful for interactions with the iframe element.
